text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My King, we have arrived at the battlefield.
At last, your maiden battle begins.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Are you mentally prepared?
Then allow me to escort you to the waiting room.
choice_data_list: You really didn't have to go that far...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No, for you are my sovereign
as well as my commander.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
We must avoid any mishaps at all costs.
Please, don't hesitate.

"Durandal treasures me dearly.
And—"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Are you not going to change, My King?
Forgive my impudence, but allow me to make a suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
When attending the race, please wear a suit
—not a tracksuit.
choice_data_list: Huh, is it not good enough... like this?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I find that questionable. You are an Emperor, not a coach.
Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Crisp top and bottom! Collar strictly neat! Handkerchief fluffy and light! Please make it just like that.

As much as she cares, her comebacks are just as sharp.
Her late-stretch kick wasn't the only thing
with a seriously keen edge.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Now then, our immediate primary goal
is to win the Make Debut, but—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
If you broaden your view... right now, across the land,
the rival lords of your generation are beginning to make their moves.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: We can't take our eyes off those developments either.
choice_data_list: Lords of the same generation, huh...

text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I've done my research too.
Speaking of Durandal's contemporaries..."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The first ones we need to watch out for
are the two who have already debuted and won.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The first one is... Symboli Kris S-san.
An Umamusume of the Symboli family who came from foreign lands.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
A sharpshooter who hits her mark no matter the strategy.
It looks like she's aiming for
the "Classic Triple Crown" route.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"And the other is
the 'Princess,' Fine Motion-san."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
An international student of royal blood from a certain nation, currently residing in Ireland.
It seems she will be taking the "Tiara Route."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
There are others too,
like Tanino Gimlet, who acts like a prince of demons,
and No Reason, who proclaims herself a general.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Looking at it this way, it seems like
there are many "noble Umamusume" in our generation.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes. A relative of the "Emperor," a princess,
a demon prince, a general, and so on...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"They are all rivals vying for supremacy against my King.
Truly a generation of contending warlords."

Nodding, yet as a Trainer,
you saw a completely different scene unfolding.
choice_data_list: Looks like there are no rivals on the sprint route, huh.
Looks like there are no rivals on the sprint route, huh?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Of the sprint division...? Now that you mention it...

"Durandal specializes in short distances
from 1,200m to 1,600m.
However, the other Umamusume's main battleground is medium distances."
In that case, even though we're from the same generation, chances to cross swords with Durandal seem scarce.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Your insight is sharp as ever. In that case, we might not clash for a while.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
In that case, rather than worrying about what lies ahead—
let's focus on today's race first!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
A pleasure to make your acquaintance.
My name is the knight, Durandal.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I offer my sword and pledge my loyalty
to the young king, <username>.
Please, watch my run!
choice_data_list: (Whoa, hearing my name said out loud is embarrassing!)

text_block_list.text: Still, if it raises Durandal's morale, I don't mind. Let us watch over them.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(1200 meters is definitely short.
Going for an immediate dash would certainly give an advantage. But—)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, if I pursue with everything I have—
My legs, this "Holy Sword," will surely shine!)

Durandal wore a grim expression.
Watching her...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hmm...?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, ah, right.
Maybe so♪

"A young horse girl watching intently by their side.
Amidst the many other spectators looking on—"
The Make Debut begins.
